title: Dana-i BLE pairing problem on Samsung S6 edge/G925F (zerolte) Android 12.1 (lineage 19.1)
symptom: After upgrading to Android 12.1, AndroidAPS cannot communicate or pair with DanaI any more. Error messages include 'Couldn't pair with JZ-DanaI-FI because of an incorrect PIN or passkey' and 'Bluetooth Low Energy not supported or device not paired'. The pump shows some communication but cannot reestablish pairing.
cause: The Samsung Galaxy S6 edge has BLE 4.1 while the Dana-I pump is BLE 5, which may cause incompatibility.
fix: Try using a recent phone that supports BLE 5, or downgrade the phone to Android 11 and remain on AAPS 3.3 to get the loop back.
evidence_quote: S6 is BLE 4.1 Dana-I is BLE 5 try in on some recent phone
